draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: The claim states Tessaline "significantly" outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU. Table T1 shows means 28.4 vs 27.6, but the only reported statistical test (S1) is for Tessaline vs PhraseGrid (cmp2), not Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT (cmp1). No test supports significance for this comparison, so "significantly" is unsupported. The numeric means are correct.
